items.text: An MBA can help career switchers when the target role expects a management credential or a campus recruiting route, but it is often not the only way, so compare the MBA with direct moves, skill proof and part-time options before taking on fees or a loan.
Define the target role, check what people actually in that role studied and compare the MBA with a direct switch using proof of work.
Ask for verifiable alumni outcomes and never rely on average salary headlines.
